reason: P06-04 adds bounded synthetic-only authenticated encryption and clean single-firm restore tooling. verify_recovery exercises wrong key/tamper/missing/hash/path/dump/firm/target rejection before resource creation, a copied package/key with all source services stopped and original paths unavailable, full table/schema/index/constraint/extension/sequence/role/column-grant/marker equality, existing DP cookie plus fresh MFA, subscription debt, invalidation and two restarts. PublicAppointmentAccessTests, BookingSmsBudgetTests and AppointmentReminderTests cover the unchanged invalidation SQL callers with real PostgreSQL and fake deliveries, including expired receipt/token 403 and stale budget startup refusal; SubscriptionLedgerTests covers restored financial history/grants. No application, identity, migration, normal Compose or dependency source changes. CI adds a scoped recovery gate, keeps existing setup/isolation gate for its own callers, and builds the operator image whenever either gate needs it. The selected pre-existing grant tests still parsed an inline PowerShell here-string removed in P06-02. All six such callers now read the existing canonical app-user-grants.sql directly, retaining every permission assertion; changed classes plus their role/transaction callers are selected.
